subject: Post-call recap: Executive summary & procurement path - NovaHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@novahealth.org>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@novahealth.org>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Executive summary & procurement path - NovaHealth

Hi Emily / Rajiv, thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap for your exec team and next steps from our side.

Key business outcomes you mentioned:
- Reduce average physician documentation time by ~20% within 6 months (goal: improve throughput without additional hires)
- Lower per-encounter NLP processing cost by 40% over current pipeline
- Improve auditability and data locality for PHI-sensitive records (on-prem / VPC requirement)

Primary pain points discussed:
- Current vendor struggles at scale during end-of-month surges; UI timeouts and inconsistent latencies
- Audit & compliance gaps: need SOC 2 + evidence of KMS/HSM integration and customer-managed keys
- Procurement risk: longer legal review because of data residency clauses and indemnity language

Technical constraints / preferences:
- Prefers dedicated private deployment (VPC) for production, with hybrid hosted API for pre-prod testing
- Latency SLO target: p95 < 250ms for 2k concurrent users; initial pilot 100-200 rps
- Must support token-level cost reports and per-route tracing for billing/showback

Attached: initial Mutual Action Plan and Redwood security summary (SOC2 excerpt).

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share a Mutual Action Plan (attached) and proposed pilot timeline by EOD Monday.
2) Aditya will follow up with a short technical note on network/connectivity and deployment options.
3) Coordinate procurement: Emily/Rajiv, can you confirm the procurement contact and expected review cycle?
4) Schedule a procurement/technical sync next week (30-45m) to review MSA & deployment checklist.

If you want an exec summary slide for your leadership, we can provide a 1-page brief for the CIO/CFO.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Mutual_Action_Plan_NovaHealth.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- Redwood_Security_Sheet_SOC2.pdf (pdf)

Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Executive summary & procurement path - NovaHealth

Thanks Marissa, useful summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- Pilot scope: we want to start with the cardiology note-taking workflow (approx. 30 clinicians) and expand based on latency and accuracy metrics.
- Procurement contact: forwarding to our procurement lead, Maya Singh (cc'd here) to start the SOW/MSA conversation.

Maya, can you share the typical contracting timeline and any mandatory clauses we should flag early (data residency, indemnity, breach notification windows)?

Rajiv
Director, Clinical Platforms
NovaHealth

Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Executive summary & procurement path - NovaHealth

Marissa, thanks for the recap and attachments. Quick notes from procurement:
- Standard timeline: initial review (legal + security) ~2-3 weeks, followed by commercial review and signature in week 4-6 depending on redlines.
- Must have SOC 2 Type II + evidence of KMS/HSM and encryption at rest for PHI. Please provide SOC 2 report and a short note on key management.
- For now, we need to see a draft MSA or confirmation you accept our standard terms; please advise if Redwood requires alternative language (we can flag in advance).

Two asks from my end:
1) Can you provide a one-page risk summary for executives (CFO/CISO) that highlights mitigations for audit & compliance?
2) Please confirm pilot pricing band (benchmark dollars/user/month or committed spend) so I can model in our procurement spreadsheet.

Thanks, Maya Singh
Procurement Lead, NovaHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@novahealth.org>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@novahealth.org>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@novahealth.org>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Executive summary & procurement path - NovaHealth

Thanks Maya, appreciate the clarity. Answers inline and next steps below.

1) SOC2 / KMS: Attached is the Redwood_Security_Sheet_SOC2.pdf (SOC2 excerpt) and a short KMS summary. Full SOC2 Type II report can be provided under NDA; we typically share via a secure portal or DocSend. Our platform supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS/HSM integrations and on-prem HSMs for Private deployments.

2) Pilot pricing: for a 30-clinician cardiology pilot we typically propose a 3-month pilot with the following band:
- Pilot package (3 months): $35k flat fee covering dedicated pre-prod environment, onboarding, and support (includes up to 100k generated tokens / inference units).
- Post-pilot: committed capacity pricing or usage-based model depending on scale (we'll include options in the MAP).

Attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_NovaHealth.xlsx (draft), includes milestones, roles, acceptance criteria, and a proposed pilot timeline beginning May 3.

Proposed next actions (I'll own coordination):
- EOD Mon: finalize MAP and send invite for procurement + technical sync (30m), owners: Marissa / Rajiv / Maya
- Wed: Aditya to send deployment checklist & network diagram + short note on expected latency performance and KV/cache strategy
- Week of May 3: Start pilot environment provisioning (private VPC) pending signed SOW

I'll also prepare a 1-page executive risk summary (CFO/CISO friendly) and a short pricing worksheet.

If helpful, happy to run a 15-minute executive briefing for your CIO/CFO to summarize business outcomes and procurement ask.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments:
- Mutual_Action_Plan_NovaHealth.xlsx (draft)
- Redwood_Security_Sheet_SOC2.pdf (excerpt)

Great recap. I'll draft the 1-page executive risk summary and pricing worksheet and share a Google Slide by Monday morning. Also happy to join the procurement sync to cover onboarding and post-signature runbook items.

Quick note on escalation: if the pilot shows latency regressions or unexpected accuracy drift, we recommend an escalation path to our Applied ML team (Aditya lead) with a 48-hour SLA for root-cause triage during the pilot.
